primary_endpoint: Change in liver fat content (hepatic fat fraction) from baseline to 12 months.
efficacy_outcome: At 12 months, liver fat content changed by −5.3% with tesamorelin and +3.6% with placebo; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events during the double-blind phase: 2/26 with tesamorelin and 3/25 with placebo; no deaths. Open-label phase: 0/30 serious adverse events and no deaths.
